restart_from_checkpoint: restart training by loading model state dict and optimizer from a checkpoint file
build_optimizer: build a PyTorch or timm optimizer from a name string and parameter dictionary
build_lr_scheduler: build a cosine or step learning rate scheduler from a name string and parameters
get_dataloader: create a DataLoader for images in a directory with optional distributed sampling support
init_distributed_mode: initialize multi-GPU or SLURM distributed training mode and set process group variables
